lane: wave-1124-sansio T0 (make the gate real), manifests-check
annoyance: 111 member dependency entries named a sibling by `path = "../x"` (or a third-party package by version), and 21 members had no [workspace.dependencies] entry at all, because nothing checked the shape: each new crate copied its neighbour's manifest. [workspace.dependencies] has never been sorted (83 keys sort before the one above them), so 'add it in sorted position' has no meaning while writers append at the end. crates/blaze-comptime is named in the root while its manifest is not yet written.
workaround: thirdparty `manifests-check` (a row of tools/gate.txt) refuses a member entry not on `workspace = true` with the line to write, and a member with no root entry; every existing one was rewritten. The unsorted table is held at 83 descents, so a new entry cannot add one.
fix: One sort of [workspace.dependencies] by key when no writer is in the root manifest, then DESCENTS = 0 in manifests.rs; a `blaze new` that writes the root entry and the member's `workspace = true` lines itself.
